//: Typecheck the dogfood files C4 owns.
WHY THIS EXISTS. The root tsconfig references only `packages/*`, so nothing under
`dogfood/` was ever typechecked, and `npx tsx` does not typecheck either. In one
phase of C4 that gap produced FOUR separate defects that all looked like working
code: a read of `zone.entryGate` on a type with no such field (which printed
'gates 0' for a world authoring three), two illegal `EntityRole` values that
crashed a converter, a MarketNode built from invented field names that crashed
another, and a missing required `hidden` that made the emitted .tscn unparseable
WHY IT IS SCOPED TO TWO FILES AND NOT ALL OF dogfood/. Pointing this at the whole
tree surfaces pre-existing errors in five files that have nothing to do with this
cycle: `import.meta` under a CommonJS module setting in three of them, a
`FidelityEntry.field` that no longer exists, and a ContentPack variance mismatch
in run-ai-rpg-smoke. Fixing those is real work and somebody's cycle, not a detour
inside this one. ANDON: named, not silently widened.
It earned its keep on the first run, finding two more live bugs in the file it was
(it is `displayName`), both silently emitting nothing into every generated fixture.
